Scope note 2 · 2026-11-27T16:12Z · N4 from the delta contract-review record 7222932507 on PR #37882 (adds to 7214316940)

- N4: in `objectLiteralMembers` the name-path lookahead reads a 200-character window, and a non-name member's text is cut from the unmasked source. (a) A bare-name spread that is the LAST member, with no trailing comma and more than ~170 characters of comment before the closing brace, reads as a text member carrying the comment (wide, not quiet; no literal is in that state today — `HookSchema` keeps its comma). (b) A comment inside a non-name spread's own span is part of that member, so rewording it derives the row (over-derivation, safe direction). Fix the record names: read the lookahead over the masked text without the window, and cut the member from comment-masked text.
- Unblocks when PR #37882 merges (this card's `Blocked-by:`).
